Items.text: Oh, thank goodness! Are you hurt? Let me look at you!
Items.name: Mom

Items.text: Easy, honey. He's alright. Aren't ya, son?
Items.name: Dad

Items.text: The Sheriff told us everything. You kept your head in there, <Name>.
Items.name: Principal Fi

Items.text: And very dangerous. That's the side of hero work we can't teach in a classroom.
Items.name: Principal Fi

Items.text: A town assignment was never supposed to end in a hostage situation. I'm so sorry.
Items.name: Ms Nice

Items.text: Hey, kid. Sorry about the dust. Figured you'd know what to do with a room full of sleeping people.
Items.name: Sandman

Items.text: But... the vault was empty. Every last bag, gone.
Items.name: Bank Guy

Items.text: And The Hole didn't have a single coin on him.
Items.name: Bank Guy

Items.text: Then where did the money go?
Items.name: Ms Nice

Items.text: You know, when you got into Tungsten High, I wasn't sure about all this superhero business.
Items.name: Dad

Items.text: But you're growing up. We know being a hero comes with days like this.
Items.name: Mom

Items.text: Now let's get you home. You've had a big day.
Items.name: Mom
